{"decision":"RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Alex, by email, relayed by Anthony 2026-09-17, in his words: "Adopt and ingest-corpus are whole repo. Reflow2 has no incremental, interactive, resumable capture mode. The unique skill: write through instead of accumulate-then-commit; the graph as worklist + memory + resume-state as an explicit contract; a typed structural-vs-intent gap with a findable deferral marker. Asking for a native incremental adopt mode needing two new primitives: a frontier query and a deferred-derivation marker." And, on why his skill exists: "A vertical slice orchestration adopt doesn't do: adopt is breadth-first over an entire repo. It says it will report false gaps if done regionally."

═══ WHAT THE DESIGN ALREADY HOLDS, piece by piece ═══
· cap:scoped-analysis — "a team asks the detectors about its own part, and is told what it did not see"; detect_gaps takes `scope` and `depth`. Two defects measured on it: a scoped detector at default depth returned two thirds of the design (2026-08-17), and a degenerate region was not flagged (2026-08-07). That is the false-gaps-on-a-region problem, with numbers.
· The adopt skill's own rule: breadth first, deliberately, because the payoff findings came from breadth; and its honest warning that a regional pass reports false gaps.
· /log-issue's `follow_up` TemporalFact (2026-09-16) — a findable, dated, owed-until-settled marker on a node, listed at every boundary. A deferred-derivation marker is that shape with a different fact_type: "structure captured, intent deliberately not yet recovered".
· Capability/Component `provenance: inferred` — the structural half already says it was read off the artifact.
· Write-through: the server keeps the export current after every change (req:the-server-keeps-the-working-tree-export-current); accumulate-then-commit is what the OLD export discipline was.

═══ THE TWO PRIMITIVES HE NAMES, in reflow2's terms ═══
(1) A FRONTIER QUERY: "what is captured structurally and not yet recovered as intent, and what is adjacent and not captured at all?" Half exists — unmotivated_capability, unsatisfied_requirement and coverage_report's unmodelled files are each a frontier from one side — and none of them is a resume point: nothing says "you were here".
(2) A DEFERRED-DERIVATION MARKER: a typed way to say "this part's intent is deliberately deferred" so the loop does not ask about it as a gap and DOES list it as owed — the follow_up shape, keyed to a node, with the structural-versus-intent distinction typed rather than in prose.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ THE TWO PRIMITIVES ON EXISTING VOCABULARY: a `deferred_derivation` fact_type read the way `follow_up` is (listed at boundaries, suppresses the intent gaps on its subject the way suppressed_by_parked_idea suppresses defects), and a `frontier` read that lists nodes with structure and no intent, nodes with a deferral marker, and unmodelled neighbours — the worklist. Then adopt gains a region mode that writes the marker on what it leaves for later. Costs: one fact_type convention, one read, a paragraph in adopt.
B. FIX THE SCOPED DETECTORS FIRST: the two recorded defects are the reason a regional adopt lies; with them fixed, a region pass may not need a new mode at all. ⚠️ Counter: even a correct scoped detector cannot tell "not yet captured on purpose" from "missing" without the marker.
C. A NEW NODE TYPE for the worklist. ⚠️ The Task-node objection that keeps reflow2 from growing one stands.
D. NOTHING: his skill does it. ⚠️ "The unique skill" is one person's; the copy drifts.

═══ THE HONEST LIMIT ═══
